sections.h2: E100 breaks even per km at Rs 72.1 a litre, just above the Rs 71.2 ethanol costs

chart.title: Taxed like petrol, E100 would cost about Rs 109 a litre, 51% more per km
chart.sub: Rs per litre, Delhi prices, October 2026.
chart.source: This blog's arithmetic; Delhi prices, Oct 2026.

sections.means: Ethanol at Rs 71.2 delivered leaves under Rs 1 a litre for excise, VAT, the dealer and the oil company's own costs.
sections.todo: Give E100 a tax rate below petrol's, as Brazil's constitution requires for biofuels, before expecting E100 sales.

sections.h2: E85 costs about 6% more per km than E20 petrol, even at Rs 82.12 a litre

chart.title: Per km, E85 costs 6% more than petrol and E100 taxed like petrol costs 51% more
chart.sub: Fuel cost per km, E20 petrol = 100.
chart.source: This blog's arithmetic; Delhi prices, Oct 2026.
rows: E100 taxed like petrol, about Rs 109

sections.means: E85 carries about 76% of petrol's energy per litre, so it costs more per km even though its pump price is 20% lower.
sections.todo: Price E85 at or below about Rs 77.7 a litre, or raise flex-fuel engine efficiency on ethanol, before drivers gain from it.
